sources.shortCitation: Signed photographic postcard of Leo Monosson, Photo C. Wolf, Berlin
sources.fullCitation: Signed photographic postcard of the singer Leo Monosson, printed credit “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin”, with his name printed below the image and an autograph across it; undated. Reproduced on Cabaret Berlin, page for Leo Monosson.

media.title: Leo Monosson — signed photographic postcard, Photo C. Wolf, Berlin
media.description: Leo Monosson on a signed photographic postcard, credited in print to “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” and captioned with his name. He sang the refrains on the Grammophon and Electrola recordings of two Kaper songs.
media.altText: Photographic postcard portrait of the singer Leo Monosson in a dark suit, signed across the lower edge.
media.publicCaption: Leo Monosson on a signed photographic postcard, credited in print to “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” and captioned with his name. He sang the refrains on the Grammophon and Electrola recordings of two Kaper songs.
media.publicCreditLine: Photo C. Wolf, Berlin; reproduced by Cabaret Berlin.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The postcard carries the printed credit “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” but no date, and nothing is known of the photographer’s death, so no term can be computed and the photograph is treated as protected. The image is displayed at 424 × 611 px, the resolution published by the source, for scholarly identification of a documented performer of Kaper’s songs.
